useCases.name: CreateTask
useCases.description:
* The user wants to add
                 * a new task to a list.

useCases.name: ViewTasks
useCases.description:
* The user wants to see
                 * all open and completed tasks.

useCases.name: CompleteTask
useCases.description:
* The user wants to mark
                 * a task as completed.

useCases.name: DeleteTask
useCases.description:
* The user wants to remove
                 * a task permanently.

useCases.name: PersistTasks
useCases.description:
* The user expects tasks to
                 * survive an application restart.

useCases.name: BrowseTaskPanel
useCases.description:
* The user wants to browse and filter
                 * all tasks in a dedicated panel.

useCases.name: ViewTaskDetails
useCases.description:
* The user wants to see a task's full details,
                 * including which list it belongs to.

useCases.name: EditTaskFields
useCases.description:
* The user wants to change a task's status
                 * or priority directly from the panel.

useCases.name: BrowseModelTree
useCases.description:
* The user wants to browse the SysML model's
                 * structure without opening files individually.

useCases.name: NavigateToModelSource
useCases.description:
* The user wants to jump from a tree element
                 * to its declaration in the SysML source.

useCases.name: ViewTraceabilityAsTree
useCases.description:
* The user wants to see a requirement's
                 * derive/verify links as navigable tree children.

requirements.name: CreateTaskRequirement
requirements.text: The user shall be able to create a new task with a title.

requirements.name: ViewTasksRequirement
requirements.text: The system shall display all tasks together with their status.

requirements.name: CompleteTaskRequirement
requirements.text: The user shall be able to mark a task as completed.

requirements.name: DeleteTaskRequirement
requirements.text: The user shall be able to delete a task.

requirements.name: PersistTasksRequirement
requirements.text: The system shall persist tasks between application restarts.

requirements.name: BrowseTaskPanelRequirement
requirements.text: The system shall provide a dedicated panel for browsing and filtering tasks by status and free-text search.

requirements.name: ViewTaskDetailsRequirement
requirements.text: The system shall show each task's full details, including which TodoList it belongs to, derived from the actual data model relationship -- not requirements/use cases, which are not part of the data model.

requirements.name: EditTaskFieldsRequirement
requirements.text: The system shall allow editing a task's status and priority from the panel, persisting changes back to the SysML model.

requirements.name: BrowseModelTreeRequirement
requirements.text: The system shall provide a tree view of the model's use cases, requirements, and test cases.

requirements.name: NavigateToModelSourceRequirement
requirements.text: The system shall let the user navigate from a tree element to its declaration in the SysML source.

requirements.name: ViewTraceabilityAsTreeRequirement
requirements.text: The system shall show a requirement's derive/verify traceability links as tree children.
